title: Side setback 3 m / 0 m (Side 1/Side 2) for plots above 250 up to 500 sqm (MPD-2047 Table 7.3, row 3)

citations.clause: Table 7.3 (Minimum Setback Norms for Plotted Housing), row 3

notes: Read from the gazette text layer, p.178. Row: '3. Above 250 up to 500 3 3 3 0' (Front, Rear, Side 1, Side 2). Side 1 = 3 and Side 2 = 0 differ; the single side parameter carries Side 1, as the UBBL rule it supersedes does. Same as UBBL p.154 (3 m, ubbl2016_compendium_2020.res_plotted.setback_side_m.250_500). effective_from is the date of S.O. 4597(E), as for Table 7.2.
user_caveat: The plan gives two different side setbacks for this band: Side 1 3 m and Side 2 0 m. Only Side 1 is shown here; check the source table to see which side takes 0 m.
